fields.label: Review inventory
fields.help: Record all ten rows here: ID | Claim | Source | State | Owner | Next action | Limit. Required IDs are PROJECT_IDENTITY, LOCKED_INSTALL, DEPENDENCY_AUDIT, PRODUCTION_BUILD, RUNTIME_HEALTH, LOG_REDACTION, CONFIG_SECRETS, HTTP_ERROR_HEADERS, DEPLOYMENT and EXCEPTIONS. Missing evidence requires UNKNOWN, an owner and the next sufficient witness. Use exactly one line per ID and seven pipe-separated cells; semicolons may be used within cells. The state selectors must match these rows. Final HTML validation checks row structure and gate coherence, not witness truth. In DOCX check the same rules manually.
